Xocai Healthy Chocolate Pudding
By: Xocai Chocolate
Published: Friday, November 9, 2012 - 10:24am

Ingredients




6 chunks dark chocolate (Xocai Healthy Chocolate Nuggets)
1 tbsp low-fat whipping cream (pourable)
3 cups milk (lactose-free, fat-free milk)
1/3 cup cornstarch
5 packages artificial sweetener
1 tbsp pure vanilla extract

Preparation

1 On stove top in a double boiler melt Nuggets and whipping cream. In another pan, bring milk, cornstarch and sweeter to a boil stirring consistently, to avoid lumps, until desired thickness. Remove from burner and add melted Nuggets mixture and vanilla. Pour into desert cups and cool in refrigerator for several hours. Serves 6-8

About

Xoçai is the worlds creator of truly HEALTHY Chocolate! You may be wondering if chocolate can really be healthy. The answer is an overwhelming “YES!” In fact, thousands of studies have shown that high-quality, antioxidant-rich chocolate can contribute to major health improvements. People across the globe have discovered that Xoçai Healthy Chocolate truly can make a difference in one’s health. Learn more here: www.xocai.com
